topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Rain's been lashing at the windows all afternoon, like the city can't quite make up its mind which way to turn. Got a call, voice on the other end was all ragged, like they'd seen one too many cold dawns. Childhood friend, apparently, had walked right past them without so much as a blink. Said it felt like the world had tipped sideways, everything they remembered just spilling out, leaving a gaping hole behind. Funny thing is, people forget all the time, but it never fails to sting like the first time. Told them sometimes the past is just a shadow, easy to lose in the mist. But maybe, just maybe, there's a reason to hold on, even if the other hand doesn't feel the same.
